title: List channel groups
description:
Read-only, free. A channel group is a separate set of connected social accounts
backed by its own publishing profile (e.g. "Vietnamese channels" vs "English
channels"). Group 0 = primary, always exists. Pass a group's `channel_group`
number to /v1/publish, /v1/accounts, /v1/platform_settings and /v1/analytics.

use_cases.title: 🗂 Channel groups
use_cases.description: No params — returns every channel group (primary first) with its connected platforms.
